parameters.name: LFO RATE
parameters.description: 14 bits: the MSB on CC 3, then the LSB on CC 35. Adjusts the LFO frequency.

parameters.name: LFO VCO AMOUNT
parameters.description: 14 bits: the MSB on CC 13, then the LSB on CC 45. Adjusts the modulation amount to the VCOs.

parameters.name: LFO VCF AMOUNT
parameters.description: 14 bits: the MSB on CC 12, then the LSB on CC 44. Adjusts the Modulation amount to the VCF.

parameters.name: LFO MIDI SYNC
parameters.description: Each name takes a band of values; the first value of it is sent. Reached over MIDI only. Enables or disables ability of LFO to sync with MIDI CLOCK messages.

parameters.name: LFO SYNC CLOCK DIV
parameters.description: Values from MIDI CC values for the LFO clock divider (p. 28 of the PDF); the first value of each band is sent. Reached over MIDI only. Sets the LFO synchronization clock divider.

parameters.name: LFO KEY TRIGGER
parameters.description: Each name takes a band of values; the first value of it is sent. Reached over MIDI only. Re-triggers the LFO to the start of the cycle (Default is OFF).

parameters.name: VCO 1 WAVE
parameters.description: Each name takes a band of values; the first value of it is sent. Selects the waveform of VCO 1.

parameters.name: VCO 2 WAVE
parameters.description: Each name takes a band of values; the first value of it is sent. Selects the waveform of VCO 2.

parameters.name: VCO 2 FREQ
parameters.description: 14 bits: the MSB on CC 17, then the LSB on CC 49. Adjusts the frequency of VCO 2. Printed: 0-127 (64 is center).

parameters.name: VCO 2 BEAT
parameters.description: Reached over MIDI only. Adjusts the beat frequency of VCO 2 (Default is 64).

parameters.name: NOTE SYNC
parameters.description: Each name takes a band of values; the first value of it is sent. Reached over MIDI only. Enables/disables Note Sync (Default is off).

parameters.name: GLIDE RATE
parameters.description: Adjusts the Glide (portamento) rate time.

parameters.name: GLIDE SWITCH
parameters.description: Each name takes a band of values; the first value of it is sent. Sets the state of the GLIDE switch (Glide is enabled when LED is lit).

parameters.name: GLIDE TYPE
parameters.description: Each name takes a band of values; the first value of it is sent. Reached over MIDI only. Selects the type of Glide; Linear Constant Rate, Linear Constant Time, or Exponential.

parameters.name: LEGATO GLIDE
parameters.description: Each name takes a band of values; the first value of it is sent. Reached over MIDI only. Sets the state of the Legato Glide parameter when GLIDE is enabled (Default is OFF).

parameters.name: VCO 1
parameters.description: 14 bits: the MSB on CC 15, then the LSB on CC 47. Adjusts the level of VCO 1.

parameters.name: VCO 2
parameters.description: 14 bits: the MSB on CC 16, then the LSB on CC 48. Adjusts the level of VC0 2.

parameters.name: EXTERNAL IN LEVEL
parameters.description: 14 bits: the MSB on CC 27, then the LSB on CC 59. Reached over MIDI only. Adjusts the level of the External Audio Input (Default is 64 = 50% level).

parameters.name: CUTOFF
parameters.description: 14 bits: the MSB on CC 19, then the LSB on CC 51. Adjusts the Filter Cutoff frequency.

parameters.name: RESONANCE
parameters.description: 14 bits: the MSB on CC 21, then the LSB on CC 53. Adjusts the Filter Resonance parameter.

parameters.name: EG AMOUNT
parameters.description: Adjusts the EG amount affecting the cutoff.

parameters.name: FILTER KB TRACK
parameters.description: 14 bits: the MSB on CC 20, then the LSB on CC 54. Reached over MIDI only. Sets the amount of keyboard tracking for the filter (Default is 32 - about 50%).

parameters.name: FILTER VELOCITY SENSITIVITY
parameters.description: Reached over MIDI only. Sets the amount of filter velocity sensitivity (Default is 64 - 50%).

parameters.name: VCF ATTACK
parameters.description: 14 bits: the MSB on CC 23, then the LSB on CC 55. Adjusts the filter envelope attack time.

parameters.name: VCF DECAY/ RELEASE
parameters.description: 14 bits: the MSB on CC 24, then the LSB on CC 56. Adjusts the filter envelope decay and release time.

parameters.name: VCF SUSTAIN
parameters.description: 14 bits: the MSB on CC 25, then the LSB on CC 57. Adjusts the filter envelope sustain level.

parameters.name: VCA ATTACK
parameters.description: 14 bits: the MSB on CC 28, then the LSB on CC 60. Adjusts the volume envelope attack time.

parameters.name: VCA DECAY/ RELEASE
parameters.description: 14 bits: the MSB on CC 29, then the LSB on CC 61. Adjusts the volume envelope decay and release time.

parameters.name: VCA SUSTAIN
parameters.description: 14 bits: the MSB on CC 30, then the LSB on CC 62. Adjusts the volume envelope sustain level.

parameters.name: RELEASE SWITCH
parameters.description: Each name takes a band of values; the first value of it is sent. Sets the state of the Release parameter (enabled when LED is lit).

parameters.name: TRIGGER MODE
parameters.description: Each name takes a band of values; the first value of it is sent. Reached over MIDI only. Sets the state of the envelope trigger (Default is Legato ON).

parameters.name: VCA (OUTPUT) LEVEL
parameters.description: 14 bits: the MSB on CC 7, then the LSB on CC 39. Reached over MIDI only. Adjusts the audio ouput and headphone volume.

parameters.name: VOLUME VELOCITY SENSITIVITY
parameters.description: Reached over MIDI only. Sets the amount of volume velocity sensitivity (Default is 64 = 50%).

parameters.name: KEY PRIORITY
parameters.description: Each name takes a band of values; the first value of it is sent. Reached over MIDI only. Sets the Note Priority (Default is last).

parameters.name: BEND UP AMOUNT
parameters.description: Each name takes a band of values; the first value of it is sent. Reached over MIDI only. Pitch Wheel 'UP' performance control (Default = +3 semitones).

parameters.name: BEND DOWN AMOUNT
parameters.description: Each name takes a band of values; the first value of it is sent. Reached over MIDI only. Pitch Wheel 'UP' performance control (Default = -3 semitones).

authoringNotes: Generated by tools/profiles/moog/make-profiles.mjs; edit the layout in tools/profiles/moog/synths/, not this file.
Every parameter is a row of the manual's MIDI tables, with its printed name. Nothing here has been sent to a real instrument yet.
No identity check: the manual prints no Device Inquiry reply.

17 knob(s) are 14-bit, 0 - 16383: the MSB and the LSB the table prints, sent in that order: LFO RATE (CC 3, LSB 35); LFO VCO AMOUNT (CC 13, LSB 45); LFO VCF AMOUNT (CC 12, LSB 44); VCO 2 FREQ (CC 17, LSB 49); VCO 1 (CC 15, LSB 47); VCO 2 (CC 16, LSB 48); EXTERNAL IN LEVEL (CC 27, LSB 59); CUTOFF (CC 19, LSB 51); RESONANCE (CC 21, LSB 53); FILTER KB TRACK (CC 20, LSB 54); VCF ATTACK (CC 23, LSB 55); VCF DECAY/ RELEASE (CC 24, LSB 56); VCF SUSTAIN (CC 25, LSB 57); VCA ATTACK (CC 28, LSB 60); VCA DECAY/ RELEASE (CC 29, LSB 61); VCA SUSTAIN (CC 30, LSB 62); VCA (OUTPUT) LEVEL (CC 7, LSB 39).
The MSB alone, 0 - 127, where the table prints an LSB for two rows or one that is another row's controller: VCO 2 BEAT (CC 18, LSB 50); EG AMOUNT (CC 22, LSB 50).
Left out, MIDI's own controller (a channel mode message), not a setting: LOCAL CONTROL OFF (CC 122), ALL SOUNDS OFF (CC 120), ALL NOTES OFF (CC 123).
Left out, printed without a range: MOD WHEEL (CC 1(MSB) 33(LSB)): -.

coverage.inboundControllers: the panel sends these same messages when its MIDI settings allow
